text:
mira: opened PR to add export examples for audit logs and a short SOC2-friendly retention blurb. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4350

ben: paste curl + python so SDK can confirm parity?

mira: curl example: curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=starlite&retain=30d&redact=true" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"format":"ndjson","since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'

isabel: for docs please say "example uses 30 days; configure retention per your policy." note that exports are available briefly (24h) and access is logged. avoid definitive SOC2 scope claims.

ben: python SDK example: from redwood import RedwoodClient; import os; c=RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']); resp=c.audit.export(tenant_id='starlite', retain='30d', redact=True, redaction_policy='pii-only', format='ndjson', since='2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'); if resp.status_code==200: print(resp.download_url)

mira: adding JSON snippet for policies: { "redaction_policy": "pii-only" } and one-liners for pii-only/full/none. also fixing a broken docs link flagged by the checker.

auditbot: automated-check: link-check failed /export-guides -> 404

mira: thanks, will push updates and request reviews. ping me after merge for QA.
